cds.text: Recognise, copy and continue repeating patterns shown in different ways
Recognise, continue and create pattern sequences with numbers, symbols, shapes and objects formed by skip counting, starting with twos, fives and tens
Recognise, describe and create additive patterns that increase or decrease by a constant amount, and identify missing elements
Recognise, continue and create repeating patterns with numbers, symbols, shapes and objects, identifying the repeating unit
Demonstrate proficiency with addition facts to 20; extend them to develop related subtraction facts
Demonstrate proficiency with multiplication facts for twos; extend to related division facts using doubling and halving
